description: Find the cheapest travel eSIM data plans for a destination from 30 providers (Airalo, Holafly, Nomad eSIM, Saily, Ubigi, Yesim and more), filtered to what a trip needs. Returns plans sorted by price (cheapest first) with data allowance, validity, price, price per GB, local network, speed policy, the date the price was checked, a page on eSIMCompare that cites the source, and a buy link. A buy link is an eSIMCompare address that takes a person on to the provider's own page for that plan after they press Continue; give it to the person rather than fetching it, since a program that opens it is shown that Continue page and not the provider. Buy links marked affiliate_link may earn eSIMCompare a commission; the price is the provider's own either way. For a provider eSIMCompare has no partnership with, the buy link is the plan's page on eSIMCompare, which offers comparable plans that can be bought through it, and where a buy link applies a reader discount the plan also gives price_through_buy_url_usd.

destination.description: Country or region, by name or ISO code: 'Japan', 'JP', 'United States', 'Europe', 'Global'.

max_price_usd.description: Highest total price in US dollars.

min_data_gb.description: Least data the trip needs, in GB. Unlimited plans always qualify.

trip_days.description: Trip length in days: plans must stay valid at least this long.
